en.LoginNote: Starts Idset in the tray at sign-in.
en.Approve: Needs approval: turn on Idset in System Settings › General › Login Items & Extensions.
en.LoginFail: Could not change the login item: %s
en.BackupNote: Backed up before adding an identity and before restoring. The newest 10 are kept in ~/.config/idset/backups/.
en.ReadOnlyBanner: accounts.json cannot be read; Idset is read-only. Restore a backup.
en.EmptyBody: Backups are made before adding an identity and before restoring.
en.ConfirmBody: The current accounts.json is backed up, then replaced. Identities after restoring:
en.ConfirmNote: Identities not in this backup are removed.
en.IncludeNote: Removes only Idset’s marker blocks. They return when an identity changes.
en.RemovedNote: Removed. They return when an identity changes.
en.RemoveFailPartial: Could not write %s: %s. The block in %s was already removed.
en.RemoveBody: Git and SSH stop choosing identities by folder.
en.Kept3: Private keys and the rest of your own config
en.KFormNote: Saved as %s and %s. An existing file is never overwritten.
en.KInvalid: Use letters, digits, ., _ and - only; do not start with . or include ..
en.KExists: %s already exists. Choose another file name.
en.KNoKeygen: ssh-keygen not found. Install the OpenSSH client.
en.KDiag: %[1]s’s private key %[2]s does not exist. The form is filled in for %[1]s.
en.PassNote: No passphrase. Add one with ssh-keygen -p -f %s.
en.AddCustom: Add the public key on your server
en.AgentFail: ssh-agent is not running. ssh reads the key file directly.
en.NextNote: On %s, add a new SSH key and paste the public key.
en.NextCustom: Give the public key to the server administrator, or add it to authorized_keys.
en.UseFail: Could not write the key to the identity: %s
en.UseTitle: Use this key for which identity?
en.UseBody: Writes only the key path and fingerprint.
en.UseNote: Cancel changes no identity; the key stays in ~/.ssh/.
en.Scanning: Reading your SSH and Git configuration…
en.ScanningSub: ~/.ssh/config and git config --global, with the files they include.
en.ReadNote: Read only; nothing is changed. Existing identities are unchecked.
en.LimitedNote: A global identity exists; those “Imported as scoped” apply once a folder is bound.
en.ImportNone: No identities found in your SSH and Git configuration
en.ImportNoneBody: Read ~/.ssh/config and git config --global. Only a Host with an IdentityFile counts.
en.ScanFail: Could not read your SSH and Git configuration: %s
en.ScanNoGit: git not found. Install Git and scan again.
en.ImportFail: Could not import %s: %s. The %d before it were imported.
en.ImportFailFirst: Could not import %s: %s. Nothing was imported.
en.ImportReadOnly: accounts.json cannot be read. Restore a backup first.
en.RegenFail: The identities were imported, but the configuration could not be written: %s

zh-Hans.LoginNote: 登录后在托盘里启动 Idset。
zh-Hans.Approve: 需要批准：在「系统设置 › 通用 › 登录项与扩展」里打开 Idset。
zh-Hans.BackupNote: 新增身份前和恢复前自动备份，保留最新 10 份，位于 ~/.config/idset/backups/。
zh-Hans.ReadOnlyBanner: accounts.json 读不出来，Idset 只读。恢复一份备份即可。
zh-Hans.EmptyBody: 新增身份前和恢复前会自动备份。
zh-Hans.ConfirmBody: 先备份当前的 accounts.json，再替换。恢复后的身份：
zh-Hans.ConfirmNote: 不在备份里的身份会被移除。
zh-Hans.IncludeNote: 只移除 Idset 的标记块；修改身份时会加回。
zh-Hans.RemovedNote: 已移除。修改身份时会加回。
zh-Hans.RemoveFailPartial: 无法写入 %s：%s。%s 里的标记块已经移除。
zh-Hans.RemoveBody: Git 和 SSH 不再按文件夹选身份。
zh-Hans.Kept3: 私钥和你自己写的其他配置
zh-Hans.KFormNote: 保存为 %s 和 %s。已有同名文件时不会覆盖。
zh-Hans.KInvalid: 文件名只能用字母、数字、.、_ 和 -，不能以 . 开头，不能含 ..。
zh-Hans.KNoKeygen: 找不到 ssh-keygen。安装 OpenSSH 客户端。
zh-Hans.KDiag: %[1]s 的私钥 %[2]s 不存在。已按 %[1]s 填好。
zh-Hans.PassNote: 没有口令。可用 ssh-keygen -p -f %s 添加。
zh-Hans.AddCustom: 在你的服务器上添加公钥
zh-Hans.AgentFail: ssh-agent 没有运行。ssh 会直接读取密钥文件。
zh-Hans.NextNote: 在 %s 新建 SSH 密钥，粘贴公钥。
zh-Hans.NextCustom: 把公钥交给服务器管理员，或加到 authorized_keys。
zh-Hans.UsedNote: 已写入 %s，配置已重新生成。
zh-Hans.UseTitle: 这把密钥用于哪个身份？
zh-Hans.UseBody: 只写入密钥路径和指纹。
zh-Hans.UseNote: 取消不改动身份，密钥留在 ~/.ssh/。
zh-Hans.Scanning: 正在读取 SSH 和 Git 配置…
zh-Hans.ScanningSub: ~/.ssh/config 和 git config --global，含它们引用的文件。
zh-Hans.ReadNote: 只读取，不修改。已有的身份默认不勾。
zh-Hans.LimitedNote: 已有全局身份，「导入为限定」的身份绑定文件夹后才生效。
zh-Hans.ImportNone: 在现有的 SSH 和 Git 配置里没找到身份
zh-Hans.ImportNoneBody: 已读取 ~/.ssh/config 和 git config --global。只有写了 IdentityFile 的 Host 才算。
zh-Hans.ScanFail: 无法读取 SSH 和 Git 配置：%s
zh-Hans.ScanNoGit: 找不到 git。安装 Git 后重新扫描。
zh-Hans.ImportFail: 导入 %s 失败：%s。前 %d 个已导入。
zh-Hans.ImportFailFirst: 导入 %s 时失败：%s。没有导入任何身份。
zh-Hans.ImportReadOnly: accounts.json 读不出来。先恢复一份备份。
zh-Hans.RegenFail: 身份已经导入，但配置没能写入：%s
